aboutUs.paragraph1: Get immediately natural and long lasting results without getting over injected, keeping a natural and most rejuvenated look without over-stuffed look, all treatments are treated with expert hands with many years of experience using the latest techniques and innovations to obtain unbeatable and natural results.
aboutUs.paragraph2: We offer a range of treatments including: Phlebotomy Services (blood draw), Cryolipolysis and Aqualyx fat dissolving treatments, Botox – Anti-wrinkles injections, Dermal Fillers, Eye bags correction, Under eyes dark circles, Rhinomodelation, Revoluminization, Neck rejuvenation, Peeling, Micro-needling, Warts, Skin tags, Moles, Millia & Cherry Angioma removal, Sclerotherapy (spider veins removal), PRP-Platelet Rich Plasma for Hair loss, Hair Thinning, Alopecia Problems, PRP face, neck & hands rejuvenation, Mesotherapy, Profhilo, CryoPen, Acne Scars, Active and Non-active Acne treatment, Rosacea, Stretch Marks, Age Spots, Dark Spots, Melasma, Skin Rejuvenation and more…
aboutUs.rightParagraph: Book with us to discuss the best options to achieve the results you want, call us today to book a consultation for a customized treatment plan created just for you.

anti-wrinkles.title: Anti Wrinkles
anti-wrinkles.description: Anti-wrinkles injections are used for reducing facial wrinkles and fine lines especially forehead lines, crow's feet, and frown lines, lifting brows or corners of the mouth, and slimming the jawline.
anti-wrinkles.tagline: Smooth, refresh and subtly lift — with expert precision

cryolipolysis.title: Cryolipolysis (Fat Freezing)
cryolipolysis.description: Cryolipolysis (Fat Freezing) eliminates stubborn fat safely and quickly without surgery, helping you lose fat and return to your best shape.
cryolipolysis.tagline: Eliminate stubborn fat — without surgery, without downtime

sunekos.title: Sunekos Treatment
sunekos.description: Sunekos is an injectable treatment containing amino acids and hyaluronic acid that stimulates fibroblasts to produce a complete extracellular matrix.
sunekos.tagline: Regenerate, hydrate and firm from within

emsculpt-neo.title: Emsculpt Neo Body Sculpting
emsculpt-neo.description: Emsculpt Neo is non-invasive technology that simultaneously burns fat and builds muscle, delivering visible results with zero downtime.
emsculpt-neo.tagline: Build muscle and burn fat simultaneously — a world first

phlebotomy.title: Phlebotomy — Blood Draw Service
phlebotomy.description: YourHealthFirst Clinic has been offering private blood draws and centrifugal services for both adults and children with gentle, expert care since 2014.
phlebotomy.tagline: Professional private blood draw and laboratory centrifuge since 2014

sculptra.title: Sculptra
sculptra.description: Injectable Poly-L-Lactic Acid that restores youthful facial contouring and natural volume gradually without looking overdone.

sclerotherapy.title: Sclerotherapy — Spider Veins
sclerotherapy.description: A targeted injectable treatment that shrinks spider veins, varicose veins and thread veins safely and effectively.
sclerotherapy.tagline: Non-invasive spider vein removal for clear, smooth skin

prp-ha.title: PRP Face & Body Rejuvenation
prp-ha.description: Non-surgical lift and cellular facial rejuvenation using platelet-rich plasma to correct skin defects and restore youthful texture.
prp-ha.tagline: Skin rejuvenation using your own platelet-rich plasma

exosome.title: Exosome Therapy
exosome.description: Advanced cellular therapy promoting intense hair and skin repair, regeneration, and rejuvenation at the deepest cellular level.
exosome.tagline: One of the most talked-about innovations in regenerative aesthetics

polynucleotides.title: Polynucleotides
polynucleotides.description: DNA nucleotide chains (PDRN) that deeply repair and regenerate skin tissue, improving dark circles, fine lines, and skin laxity.
polynucleotides.tagline: Advanced regenerative therapy for skin and under-eyes

prp-hair-loss.title: PRP Hair Loss Treatment
prp-hair-loss.description: Three-step medical PRP therapy where your blood is drawn, concentrated and injected into the scalp to restore hair growth and density.
prp-hair-loss.tagline: Clinically proven — restore density, strengthen and regrow

microneedling.title: Microneedling
microneedling.description: Sterilised micro-needles stimulate natural collagen production, improving skin elasticity, firmness, texture and reducing scars.
microneedling.tagline: Stimulate your skin's natural collagen production

mesotherapy.title: Mesotherapy
mesotherapy.description: Virtually pain-free U225 intradermal micro-injections delivering targeted vitamins, amino acids and antioxidant cocktails directly into the dermis.

photo-aging.title: Chemical Peels (Photodynamic Peel)
photo-aging.description: Skinox photosensitive treatment combined with High Density Diode HDD laser therapy for blemishes, dark spots, redness and sun damage.
photo-aging.tagline: Photodynamic therapy & medical peels for total skin renewal

profhilo.title: Profhilo
profhilo.description: Ultra-pure hyaluronic acid bioremodelling treatment that deeply hydrates, lifts and firms the face, neck, hands and décolletage.

dermal-fillers.title: Dermal Fillers
dermal-fillers.description: Premium hyaluronic acid fillers to restore lost facial volume, smooth deep folds, and enhance lips and cheekbones with instant, natural results.
dermal-fillers.tagline: Restore volume, define contours, refresh your look

aqualyx.title: Aqualyx (Fat Dissolving)
aqualyx.description: Clinically proven fat-dissolving injection that permanently destroys localized fat cells in the double chin, abdomen, and thighs.
aqualyx.tagline: Permanently dissolve stubborn fat — precisely targeted

cryopen.title: CryoPen
cryopen.description: Precision cryotherapy to gently and quickly remove skin tags, warts, milia, age spots and cherry angiomas with minimal discomfort.
cryopen.tagline: Fast, precise and safe removal of benign skin lesions

vitamin-b12.title: Vitamin B12 Injections
vitamin-b12.description: Direct intramuscular booster delivering rapid energy, improved metabolism, mental clarity, and strengthened immunity.
vitamin-b12.tagline: Boost energy, metabolism and wellbeing — fast

mounjaro.title: Mounjaro (Weight Loss)
mounjaro.description: Medically supervised weekly tirzepatide injections for effective appetite regulation and sustained medical weight loss.
mounjaro.tagline: The clinically approved breakthrough in medical weight loss

prp-face-body.title: PRP Face & Body Rejuvenation
prp-face-body.description: Non-surgical lift and cellular facial rejuvenation using platelet-rich plasma to correct skin defects and restore youthful texture.
prp-face-body.tagline: Skin rejuvenation using your own platelet-rich plasma

faq.heading: frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can book an appointment by calling us on 0207 225 3582 or 078 1847 4041, or by emailing info@yourhealthfirst.uk. We're based at 2 Wimpole Street, London W1G 0EB. Our friendly team will help you find a time that suits you and answer any questions before your visit.
faq.a2: We offer a comprehensive range of aesthetic and medical treatments including anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, Profhilo, Polynucleotides, Sculptra, PRP therapy, Sunekos, Cryolipolysis (fat freezing), Emsculpt Neo, Aqualyx, Mounjaro, hair loss treatments (PRP & Exosomes), Microneedling, Mesotherapy, Sclerotherapy, CryoPen, and Vitamin B12 injections.
faq.q3: Do I need a consultation before treatment?
faq.a3: Yes — every new patient begins with a thorough one-to-one consultation with Dr Sofia. This allows us to understand your concerns, assess your suitability for treatment, and design a personalised plan tailored to your goals. Consultations are relaxed and informative with no pressure to proceed.
faq.q4: Are the treatments safe for all skin types?
faq.a4: Our treatments are suitable for a wide range of skin types and tones. During your consultation Dr Sofia will assess your skin in detail and recommend the most appropriate treatments for your individual needs. Safety and natural-looking results are always our top priority.
faq.q5: How long does a treatment session take?
faq.a5: Treatment times vary depending on the procedure. A quick anti-wrinkle injection session may take as little as 15–20 minutes, while more comprehensive treatments such as Cryolipolysis or Emsculpt Neo can take 45–60 minutes per session. We will always give you a clear time estimate when you book.
faq.a6: Results timelines differ by treatment. Anti-wrinkle injections typically show effect within 3–14 days. Dermal fillers and Profhilo show results almost immediately, improving further over several weeks. Body contouring treatments such as Cryolipolysis generally show visible results after 8–12 weeks. Dr Sofia will guide you on what to expect during your consultation.
